scope: Codex subprocess completion, output drain, timeout and cancellation

before.observed: The process wait finished, but stream gather had no deadline. The outer 5-second guard cancelled the scenario and pytest failed.
before.historical_symptom: Historical runs also retained concurrent stream-read errors from cleanup calling communicate while stream readers existed.

changes: One deadline now covers stdin, process completion and stdout/stderr EOF.
Cleanup no longer calls communicate against active stream readers.
Process-tree termination and bounded final drain apply to timeout and cancellation.
Intent experiment stdout/stderr are saved incrementally, including interrupted calls.

after.lifecycle_regressions: 3 passed, including real timeout and cancellation child processes
after.live_api_metrics: A new generated task published; metrics endpoint returned its two retained Core sessions and zero revisions.
after.boundary: This demonstrates lifecycle handling and observed local runs; it does not remove external transport outages or establish production SLA.
